completion_scope: Protocol specification only; native interrupted provider attempt is preserved separately and no provider success is claimed.

criteria.criterion: Protocol has an immutable version/hash before final runs, with model settings, all arms, metrics, and data-access boundaries.
criteria.explanation: Content-addressed ns-core-v1 defines matched A–D and two single-mechanism contrasts, actual disclosed Terra HIGH maintenance availability, nonzero genuine historical-repair recruitment, separate dev/pilot/final schedules and hidden-oracle boundaries. The bundle hashes are verified. Final source/model/task/scorer/runtime/resource qualification remains explicitly with NS-005/006/016; no final readiness or experiment is claimed.

criteria.criterion: Noninferiority margin, minimum useful completion threshold, CI method, and promotion/no-promotion criteria are specified before final outcomes.
criteria.explanation: Predeclares 0.05 absolute noninferiority margin, 0.25 robust useful-family completion floor, conservative paired exact-binomial component bounds, cold/warm alpha splitting, family-clustered descriptive bootstrap, strict safety/progress/efficiency gates, and no-promotion for missing/negative/inconclusive evidence. Planned N=16 independent final families is explicitly a bounded feasibility design without a power guarantee.

criteria.criterion: Actual versus estimated/unavailable cost fields and amortization horizons are defined.
criteria.explanation: Defines actual/estimated/unavailable values with provenance, null reasons, provider tokens/charges, every setup/call/teardown/proof/storage/recovery/scoring/human cost, directly measured elapsed, finite effect/CPU/wall/storage ceilings, and H=1/10/100/1000 amortization and break-even rules. Host availability is distinguished from reserved capacity and billing availability.

criteria.criterion: Simulations and checked-in oracle patches cannot count as live repair results.
criteria.explanation: Excludes old forty fixtures, target-patch replay, synthetic oracle outcomes, no-call/deny-all controls and sealer replays from live repair results. Requires source-preimage provenance, independent hidden acceptance, actual valid residual proposals and current evidence/publication. Seven structural negative schema cases fail; these are schema checks, not measured research results.

limitations: No new provider invocation, live benchmark repair, final source population, independent oracle or promotion decision was produced by NS-004.
Observed maintenance Terra HIGH access is not a reservation or scientific adapter qualification; native quota guard, actual source/model matching and resources remain mandatory.
The original provider-dispatched attempt log and private projection were preserved outside the publishable candidate. No provider receipt/history is rewritten by this candidate.
All counts are preregistered planned counts. Final quality may be inconclusive; this task does not narrow or complete the paper goal.
